name: Doling Justice
summary: In Feralas, Jer'kai Moonweaver and Kindal are ready to strike back after the sprite darters' rescue. Jer'kai asks you to thin the Grimtotem ranks, then return to him.

sections.title: Taking the Fight to the Grimtotem
sections.body:
After the sprite darter rescue, Jer'kai Moonweaver and Kindal are ready to strike at the Grimtotem. They can thin the tauren ranks together without much risk, and welcome your help.

You have seen the camp below, and more lie to the east. Choose your own tactics against Grimtotem Naturalists, Raiders and Shamans, then return to Jer'kai.

faq.answer: In Feralas, Jer'kai Moonweaver asks for your help after Kindal has explained what they plan following the sprite darter rescue.
The targets are Grimtotem Naturalists, Grimtotem Raiders and Grimtotem Shamans among the Grimtotem clan.
One Grimtotem camp lies below Jer'kai, in sight, and he says more camps lie to the east.
Freedom for All Creatures comes first. There, you freed the sprite darters from the Grimtotem camp.
